_comment: Every Terraform root folder CI knows about. fmt/validate/tflint run on all of them; plan and apply only where the flag is true. Adding an environment = adding one entry. 'why' explains any flag that is false.

roots.name: bootstrap
roots.why: Never auto-applied: the pipeline must not edit its own permissions. Apply by hand.

roots.name: dev
roots.why: EC2 Mac. Applying creates a mac2.metal host with a 24h minimum bill. Off until TSL-44 (rent-a-mac).
